# GuardManager

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/aae683920cd57dc96d920c3e2d788e226f098aef/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/base/GuardManager.sol)

**Inherits:** [SelfAuthorized](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/common/abstract.SelfAuthorized)

**Title:** Guard Manager - A contract managing transaction guards which perform pre and post-checks on Safe transactions.

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Constants

### GUARD_STORAGE_SLOT

```solidity
bytes32 internal constant GUARD_STORAGE_SLOT = 0x4a204f620c8c5ccdca3fd54d003badd85ba500436a431f0cbda4f558c93c34c8;
```

## Functions

<a id="setguard-address"></a>

### setGuard

<i>

Set a guard that checks transactions before execution
     This can only be done via a Safe transaction.
     ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Since a guard has full power to block Safe transaction execution,
       a broken guard can cause a denial of service for the Safe. Make sure to carefully
       audit the guard code and design recovery mechanisms.

</i>

Set Transaction Guard `guard` for the Safe. Make sure you trust the guard.

```solidity
function setGuard(address guard) external authorized;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| guard | `address` | The address of the guard to be used or the 0 address to disable the guard |

<a id="getguard"></a>

### getGuard

<i>

Internal method to retrieve the current guard
     We do not have a public method because we're short on bytecode size limit,
     to retrieve the guard address, one can use `getStorageAt` from `StorageAccessible` contract
     with the slot `GUARD_STORAGE_SLOT`

</i>

```solidity
function getGuard() internal view returns (address guard);
```

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| guard | `address` | The address of the guard |

## Events

### ChangedGuard

```solidity
event ChangedGuard(address indexed guard);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| guard | `address` |  |
